title: Reg E Subpart B (1073) Remittance Transfers With AI Agents: The 30-Minute Cancellation Window, the Pre-Payment Disclosure, and the Error-Resolution Timeline the Bank Cannot Miss
summary: The remittance transfer rule at Reg E Subpart B is where a consumer's international transfer becomes a specific federal-compliance surface with specific disclosure content, a specific cancellation window, and a specific error-resolution timeline the bank has to run correctly for every consumer transfer. The rule's mechanics have specific timing that maps to specific system-design constraints the AI agent operates against, and the specific compliance points are the specific engineering discipline the bank's remittance program has to enforce.
